name: Sodatete Miryu? ~Boku to Lilith no Chotto Fushigi na Monogatari~
original_name: 育ててみりゅ？ ～ぼくとリリスのちょっとふしぎな物語～
source:
In a little village somewhere and somewhen, young Abel (the protagonist) and his older sister Cecilia, a couple of orphans, live together in the little house of their long lost parents. Their life is simple but happy, and supported by Cecilia's occasional sales of (conveniently) natural products collected from the village forest and, more importantly, from Abel's job as shepherd at a nearby farm.
It's only when the game starts following Abel's daily routine that we discover that the story is set in a fantasy world, because the native sheep have a (female) humanoid form...

[From a [url=http://www.jastusa.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=6381]forum post[/url] by Baldo]
translation:
在某个地方的一个小村庄里，年轻的阿贝尔（主角）和他的姐姐塞西莉亚，一对孤儿，一起住在失散多年的父母的小房子里。他们的生活简单而幸福，塞西莉亚偶尔出售从村庄森林收集的（方便的）天然产品，更重要的是，从阿贝尔在附近农场当牧羊人的工作中收集的天然产品支撑着他们的生活。
直到游戏按照亚伯的日常生活开始时，我们才发现故事发生在一个奇幻世界，因为当地的羊有（女性）人形形态……

[来自Baldo的 [url=http://www.jastusa.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=6381]论坛帖子[/url]]
